The '''Pelgrin sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Its trailing boundary bordered the [[Tolonda sector/Legends|Tolonda sector]], and, moving clockwise, it also bordered the [[Dalchon sector/Legends|Dalchon]] and [[Gaulus sector/Legends|Gaulus sectors]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The area within the sector was considered well-explored by [[25 BBY/Legends|25 BBY]], and in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] the average population of a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the sector was less than one million.<ref name="TEA" /> It contained the [[Rordak system/Legends|Rordak system]],<ref name="EAOC" /> which contained [[Rordak]], the desolate and mountainous [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Viska (species)|Viska]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="PGV1" />
